column3: Close to the Hebrew; the oath formula “if my lips speak…” is rendered as a plain negative, “My lips will not speak.”
NKJV renders “if he cuts off” as “Though he may gain much,” and חָנֵף (“the godless”) as “the hypocrite.”
Close to the Hebrew; “buried by death [plague]” is rendered “buried in death.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV takes the east wind as subject, “It hurls against him,” and “from its hand” as “from its power.”
